name: Ayasaki Wakana
source:
Wakana lives in Kyoto (京都), Kyoto and goes to Siun Girls High School (紫雲女子高校) where she is a third year student in class C.

She likes Japanese tea ceremony, looking at temples, and kabuki. She's also in the archery club at school. Her favorite subjects are Japanese history, math, and physics.
